title: Fisher scoring for a Poisson model
brief: Build the bend table X^T D X, take Newton steps with it, and fit Poisson, Gaussian, and Bernoulli models with one loop.
hints: The information is (X * var[:, None]).T @ X, where var = variance_from_natural(family, X @ w). On the shop data at zero weights it is [[3, 3], [3, 5]].
newton_step returns the step delta = np.linalg.solve(info, grad), not the new weights. The update is w = w - delta.
In fit_fisher_scoring, append the loss before each step and stop, without stepping, when the gradient norm is below tol.
